integrity: Analytic proof supplied for all infinite-dimensional conclusions. Finite checks are ancillary. No independent review or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The general equality requires a superlacunary increasing spectral sequence and a Schauder decomposition. The interval examples establish sharp existence in one family on c0, not classification of all semigroups. A covering implicit classical formulation remains a literature risk.
title: Schauder tail geometry and prescribed initial norm-jump intervals
